title: Create reproducible Cargo workspace
deliverable: Four minimal crate boundaries, pinned compiler, Cargo.lock, inherited lints and run instructions
acceptance: Check, fmt and a minimal documented library test pass; no accidental GUI/SQL dependency in core.
evidence: app/docs/R0-01-VERIFICATION.md: Windows fmt/check/Clippy, 3 integration tests + 1 doc test, API docs, debug/release builds and bootstrap launches; dependency boundaries verified 2026-11-05

title: Run the native egui shell
deliverable: Toolbar, sidebar, inspector and selectable class preview
acceptance: Debug and release builds launch on Windows; adapter failures have useful diagnostics.
evidence: app/docs/WINDOWS-REVIEW-2026-11-05.md: Windows debug/release windows rendered; native selection, rename and Escape checked; automated diagnostics and shell tests passed.

title: Verify native storage build prerequisites
deliverable: Bundled rusqlite compile/link and temporary database smoke check
acceptance: Temporary write/read closes cleanly; no separately installed SQLite runtime required by that test.
evidence: app/docs/WINDOWS-REVIEW-2026-11-05.md: Bundled SQLite compiled/linked with MSVC; temporary write/close/reopen/integrity/read/delete test passed; release imports no sqlite3.dll.

title: Validate GUI text, focus and accessibility
deliverable: Native English/Arabic/mixed text, IME, keyboard, screen-reader/object-list and DPI matrix
acceptance: Essential input/navigation works or a documented GUI reconsideration blocks the gate.
evidence: app/docs/WINDOWS-REVIEW-2026-11-05.md: English rename, Escape focus and mixed English/Arabic sample observed. Full bidi/IME/screen-reader/DPI matrix remains incomplete.

title: Review the native foundation gate
deliverable: Prototype evidence and updated GUI/toolchain ADR
acceptance: Framework decision is supported by real behavior; no hidden prerequisite or essential text failure remains.

title: Define design tokens and base components
deliverable: Semantic light and dark tokens, including a control-border token, applied through egui visuals, plus reusable button, field, list-row and panel components (tabs arrive with UI-05)
acceptance: Every foreground/background and control-border pair is measured and recorded (4.5:1 text, 3:1 control boundaries); light, dark and system choices work without restart; existing shell tests still pass.
evidence: app/docs/ui/UI-01-TOKENS-AND-COMPONENTS.md: light/dark tokens and components in ui/theme.rs and ui/components.rs; 8 tests in tests/theme.rs check every contrast pair (control border 3.1-4.3:1 after replacing the failing planned value) and live Light/Dark/System switching; 19 existing desktop tests still pass; light and dark screenshots from the real window.

title: Specify type scale and text roles
deliverable: Type scale (title, panel title, body, label, code), role usage, fallback chain and text-direction rules for names and members
acceptance: Roles are applied through one theme module; right-to-left and mixed-text rules cite the R0-04 bidi result or are marked open; longer labels are checked at the supported sizes.

title: Build the responsive workspace
deliverable: Header, tab row, tool row, resizable navigator and inspector, status row, drawer layout and toolbar overflow
acceptance: Headless tests at 800x500, 1280x800 and 1440x900 find no overlapping or unreachable controls; focus returns after a drawer closes; Windows check at 100/150/200% scale.

title: Design welcome, new-project and open screens
deliverable: Welcome with recent files, missing-file handling and recovery entry; new-project form; open flow using fixture data
acceptance: Validation appears beside fields; only implemented diagram types are offered; cancelling leaves state unchanged; every screen is reachable by keyboard.

title: Build navigator and diagram tabs
deliverable: Diagrams/Model tabs, search, hierarchy, rename and duplicate entries, diagram tabs with overflow and per-tab drafts, using labeled fixtures
acceptance: No items and no search results are distinct states; selecting in the navigator reveals the object; closing a tab never discards model changes.

title: Define the tool and command catalog
deliverable: One catalog of commands with availability and reason, shortcuts, menu/toolbar/palette projection and the shortcut priority order
acceptance: Every toolbar, menu and palette entry comes from the catalog; disabled entries state a reason; shortcuts ignore keys while a text field had focus in the previous frame (tested).

title: Present canvas states
deliverable: Blank, none/one/multi selection, relation, inline edit, move/resize/connect preview, invalid target and read-only presentations
acceptance: Each state has a headless scenario test and an accessible name; selection never relies on color alone; Escape cancels previews.

title: Build the contextual inspector
deliverable: No-selection, node, relation and multi-select inspectors with Model and Appearance sections and a member editor surface
acceptance: Mixed values are shown explicitly and never replaced silently; validation messages sit beside fields and keep focus; every field has an accessible label.

title: Build dialogs, status bar and validation drawer
deliverable: Close/discard, delete-impact, export, settings and recovery dialogs; persistent save status; validation drawer with Go to object
acceptance: One modal owns focus at a time; focus is restored on cancel; a failed save is shown persistently as text rather than a transient message; cancelling a native dialog changes nothing.

title: Check keyboard, focus and accessibility
deliverable: Focus order and shortcut map, accessible names and states for every surface, contrast of hover/disabled/selected/pressed states and Narrator/NVDA notes
acceptance: Every essential action works without a pointer; the contrast table covers all states; real screen-reader results are recorded or listed as blockers.

title: Define the notation capability contract
deliverable: Notation definition (name, tools, inspector sections, allowed relations, capabilities) with Class as the only implemented entry
acceptance: The type picker lists only implemented notations; a second notation defined with a test double needs no change to shared shell code.

title: Review the native UI gate
deliverable: Native screenshots at supported sizes in both themes, scenario fixtures and integration contracts reviewed
acceptance: Every surface and state in 07-UI-PLAN.md section 4 exists with a fixture; no essential keyboard, contrast or text failure remains; limits are recorded; no persistence or command behavior is claimed.

title: Define typed IDs and document records
deliverable: Classes/members/relations, diagrams/views, finite geometry and explicit ordering
acceptance: Model IDs and view IDs cannot be interchanged; checked construction rejects invalid geometry.

title: Implement domain and relation validation
deliverable: Reference, ownership, association and generalization checks
acceptance: Invalid references, self-generalization and cycles produce typed errors without edits.

title: Apply reversible command transactions
deliverable: Command enum, validated ChangeSet and inverse patches
acceptance: Compound creation/removal is atomic; a failed command preserves the previous document.

title: Add history and saved-state identities
deliverable: Undo/redo, SessionId, Revision, StateId and bounded history
acceptance: Undo returns to the correct semantic state; saved-state tracking survives undo/redo and branching.

title: Validate persistence DTOs and schema v1
deliverable: Independent versioned SQLite schema and checked load adapter
acceptance: Malformed/newer unsupported inputs do not enter live state or get rewritten silently.

title: Implement transactional save and publication
deliverable: Existing-file transaction, safe initial/Save As publication, migration and recovery foundations
acceptance: Injected write/publication errors preserve previous committed data and return typed causes.

title: Define bounded worker job protocol
deliverable: Owned snapshots, SaveRequestId and worker-owned connection
acceptance: Old session/revision results cannot clear new edits; pending work is bounded and orderly.

title: Pass headless foundation fixtures
deliverable: Command, multi-view, storage-failure and roundtrip evidence
acceptance: Reference invariants pass through public APIs without starting the GUI.

title: Build shared scene and picking geometry
deliverable: Transforms, text measurement boundary, shapes, polylines, labels and hit regions
acceptance: Coordinate roundtrips and picking order remain correct at supported zoom/DPI values.

title: Implement gesture preview state machine
deliverable: Select/pan/marquee/move/resize/connect/text states
acceptance: Release commits once; Escape and capture loss discard previews without semantic mutation.

title: Wire project navigation and editor session
deliverable: Diagrams/Model sidebar, name search, tabs, selection and inspector context
acceptance: Opening/selecting objects stays consistent across sidebar, canvas and inspector.

title: Deliver class and member editing
deliverable: Class placement, inline names, ordered attributes/operations and typed inspector drafts
acceptance: User edits create one semantic command; text editing does not invoke canvas shortcuts.

title: Deliver relations and attached routes
deliverable: Association/generalization tools, role/multiplicity and basic routing/anchors
acceptance: Relations follow moved/resized views and reject invalid endpoints without partial state.

title: Expose reuse and duplication explicitly
deliverable: Show in diagram, Duplicate model and model/appearance scope
acceptance: Shared rename affects both views; geometry/style remains view-local; duplication uses new IDs.

title: Integrate command history with native actions
deliverable: Undo/redo and dirty-state feedback across gestures/member/relation/reuse edits
acceptance: One undo reverses one user action while preserving references and normal text undo.

title: Pass the class vertical-slice walkthrough
deliverable: Native Customer/Order/PreferredCustomer fixture and saved/reopened evidence
acceptance: Names, members, inheritance, multiplicity, views, routes and identity match after reopen.

title: Bind project and navigation lifecycle
deliverable: New, open, recent and close flows and the navigator bound to the real session
acceptance: Opening an invalid or newer file keeps the current session; closing a dirty project offers Save, Discard and Cancel and never loses data.

title: Bind inspector and member editing
deliverable: Inspector, member editor and rename drafts issue real commands
acceptance: Each accepted edit is one undo step; invalid drafts stay editable; a rename updates every view.

title: Bind canvas gestures and history
deliverable: Gesture previews commit one command; Undo, Redo, context menu and palette use the command catalog
acceptance: Escape or capture loss leaves the document unchanged; every menu action has keyboard and toolbar access.

title: Bind save and validation status
deliverable: Status bar, save acknowledgments and validation drawer bound to worker results
acceptance: Stale results are ignored; a failed save stays visible with Retry and Save As; dirty state is correct after undo and redo.

title: Complete the keyboard workflow
deliverable: Full create-to-save class workflow without a pointer
acceptance: The walkthrough in 07-UI-PLAN.md section 9 completes with the keyboard only and passes headless and native checks.

title: Export SVG from the shared scene
deliverable: Escaped SVG with bounds, labels, members and arrowheads
acceptance: Output parses and renders the declared subset without editor handles; font limits documented.

title: Polish shared editing and history limits
deliverable: Multi-selection, alignment/basic grouping/styles and memory-bounded history feedback
acceptance: Compound edits undo coherently; history eviction drops whole entries and never breaks references.

title: Finish save, close and recovery UX
deliverable: Save As, explicit errors, autosave snapshots and close/recovery choices
acceptance: Failed saves keep dirty work and previous data; cancellation does not lose the project.

title: Pass complete native usability checks
deliverable: Keyboard/text/IME/accessibility/DPI tests and representative task observations
acceptance: Results and gaps are recorded; no unsupported claims of easier use.

title: Profile release workloads
deliverable: Recorded baseline/medium fixtures, frame/save/load/memory and idle measurements
acceptance: Measured hotspots guide any optimization; proposed budgets are distinguished from passed results.

title: Validate Windows distribution
deliverable: Release artifact, notices, run guide and clean-machine smoke matrix
acceptance: Supported target runs without developer tools; graphics/runtime requirements are explicit.

title: Approve the basic v0.1 release gate
deliverable: Passed checks, native scenario, known limitations and reproducible release record
acceptance: No known data-loss bug; defined class scope, recovery and SVG workflows all pass.

title: Review final visual, accessibility, recovery and export
deliverable: Final native screenshots, contrast, screen-reader, recovery and export review
acceptance: Both themes pass at 100/150/200% scale; failed-save and recovery paths display correctly; known limits are listed.

title: Add Flowchart notation
deliverable: Typed shapes/flows, palette, inspector, constraints and fixtures
acceptance: Meaningful native workflow passes reuse/undo/roundtrip/export checks.

title: Add Use Case notation
deliverable: Actors/use cases, declared relation subset and fixtures
acceptance: Connections and editing rules are explicit; shared engine infrastructure is reused.

title: Review real notation reuse
deliverable: Cross-notation regression and focused abstraction review
acceptance: No duplicated file/history/session stack; abstractions reflect demonstrated common decisions.

title: Deliver an ER modeling subset
deliverable: Entities/columns/keys/cardinality and complete declared workflow
acceptance: Typed schema and visual compartments remain consistent through edits, undo and storage.

title: Deliver Activity and State subsets
deliverable: Separate constrained activity/state schemas and interaction policies
acceptance: Containment and transitions have meaningful native and roundtrip fixtures.

title: Scope and deliver Requirements/SysML adapters
deliverable: Declared requirements/block/port/constraint subsets and traceability rules
acceptance: Accepted adapters have typed semantics; no blanket full-standard parity claim.

title: Deliver dedicated Sequence editing
deliverable: Lifelines, message order, activations, fragments and temporal interaction strategy
acceptance: Insertion/reordering and numbering preserve semantics through undo/save/export.

title: Review specialized-family release gates
deliverable: Family-specific acceptance evidence and updated schema/compatibility policy
acceptance: Each delivered family is a working domain workflow, not only a visible palette.

title: Propose interchange and richer output epics
deliverable: Separate designs for accepted PNG/PDF/report/VP XML compatibility work
acceptance: Input/output, field preservation, fixtures and compatibility limits are approved before coding.

title: Propose remaining notation and engineering scope
deliverable: Prioritized selections from the 101-type inventory plus code/DB tooling proposals
acceptance: No implicit promise to implement every constant; each chosen epic has an outcome and effect boundary.

title: Propose collaboration and extension architecture
deliverable: Requirements for versioned automation/plugin boundary and collaboration mode
acceptance: Concurrency/merge/identity and runtime extension contracts are designed separately from the local app.
